name: zap-mcp
description: Read and reply to the WhatsApp chats you allowed in the Zap MCP Mac app.
long_description: Bridge to the Zap MCP menu bar app. The app links your WhatsApp accounts and decides which chats Claude can see and whether it may send; this extension only forwards Claude's requests to it. The tools work only while the app is running on this Mac.

tools.name: list_chats
tools.description: List the chats you allowed Claude to see.

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Read messages from an allowed chat.

tools.name: get_media
tools.description: Open an image, video, audio or document from a message.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a text message (may require your approval).

tools.name: send_file
tools.description: Send a file (always requires your approval).
